# ⚡ Neon Prompt Studio — Ultimate Edition
![PWA](https://img.shields.io/badge/PWA-Ready-8A2BE2) ![Offline](https://img.shields.io/badge/Offline--First-verified-00E5FF) ![Vanilla JS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Vanilla-JavaScript-F7DF1E) ![Prompts](https://img.shields.io/badge/prompts-124-FF4D6D) ![QA](https://img.shields.io/badge/QA-offline_test_PASS-25D366) ![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-green) **A cyberpunk, fully offline, installable PWA for managing, creating, organizing, and discovering AI prompts.** [🚀 **Live Demo**](https://imxforever.github.io/Neon-Prompt-Studio/)

## ✨ Features | | | |---|---| | 📚 **124 curated prompts** | Across 9 categories: Artistic, Character, Emotional, Fantasy, Professional, Humor, Cultural, Nature, Other | | 🔍 **Instant search + filters** | Live search, category filter, favorites view, A–Z sort (`Ctrl+F` to jump in) | | ✏️ **Custom builder** | Create your own prompts with **live chars/words/~tokens counter**, validation, edit support | | ⭐ **Favorites** | One-click save, persistent, favorite-first sorting | | 🎲 **Random generator** | One-click inspiration roll + copy + favorite | | 🏆 **XP & gamification** | Levels, achievements, streaks, confetti, sound-free celebration | | 🧠 **Neon Coach** | Tips, mind-streams and motivation boosts while you work | | 📤 **Export / Import** | Full backup as JSON, validated import with error toasts | | 🌓 **Dark / Light** | Neon dark default + light mode, persisted | | 📱 **True offline PWA** | Installable, app shortcuts (Browse/Add/Random/Favorites), share-target, protocol handler | ## 🚀 Run **Live (GitHub Pages):** **Locally:** ```bash git clone https://github.com/ImXforever/Neon-Prompt-Studio.git cd Neon-Prompt-Studio python3 -m http.server 8000 # → http://localhost:8000 ``` > 📲 Install it: open the demo → browser menu → *Install app*. Works fully offline afterwards (verified by automated offline-reload test). ## 🏗 Architecture ```mermaid flowchart TD I[index.html
~2900 lines: library + builder + XP + coach] O[offline.html
graceful fallback page] SW[service-worker.js v4
fault-tolerant cache: navigate + assets + fonts] M[manifest.json
icons + shortcuts + screenshots + share-target] LS[(localStorage
prompts + favorites + XP + theme)] SH[screenshot-desktop/mobile.png
rich install UI] I --> LS SW -.-> I & O & M M -.-> I M --> SH ``` One self-contained app file (HTML+CSS+JS, zero JS dependencies — only Google Fonts CDN with offline fallback), one PWA shell, `localStorage` persistence. ## 📁 Repository layout ``` ├── index.html ⚡ the app (~2.9K lines) ├── offline.html 📡 fallback page ├── service-worker.js 📦 v4 cache (navigate-first + assets + fonts) ├── manifest.json 📱 full PWA manifest ├── screenshot-desktop.jpg 🖼️ 1366×768 install screenshot ├── screenshot-mobile.jpg 🖼️ 375×812 install screenshot ├── icon-*.png (11) 🎨 icons incl. maskable + favicon ├── generate-icons.sh 🛠️ icon generator helper └── LICENSE 📄 MIT ``` ## 🛠 Debug v1.1 — what was fixed Found with static analysis + headless browser QA (offline test went from **FAIL → PASS**): 1. **Offline actually works now** — removed 2 dead font URLs (404) + added the 2 missing screenshots the cache list required; install is fault-tolerant (`allSettled`, cache v4) 2. **Pages-ready paths** — 27 absolute `/…` URLs in manifest + SW + HTML → relative (subpath-safe) 3. **Navigate fallback can never return `undefined`** — synthetic offline response as last resort 4. **Shortcuts & notification actions work** — `?action=` router (add/random/favorites) with click-delegation (zero coupling) 5. **Share-to-app works** — `?text=`/`?prompt=` prefill the Add modal via `openModal(editData)` 6. **offline.html rewritten** — honest copy + Retry button 7. **Global error toast** — visible but non-blocking (`error` + `unhandledrejection`) 8.. 🆕 **NEW: live token counter** in the Add modal (`chars · words · ~tokens`, ⌁chars/4 heuristic) 9. Added MIT `LICENSE` (was missing) Known minor: slight top-bar/search overlap on very small screens (cosmetic, needs a design decision, untouched). ## 🧪 Testing Automated headless QA: 0 console/page errors on all pages, offline-reload PASS, `?action=` + share-prefill + token-counter verified. ## 🤝 Contributing Bug reports and PRs welcome. Keep it dependency-free and offline-first; keep the SW cache list in sync. ## 📄 License [MIT](LICENSE) © 2026 ImXforever

#!/bin/bash

# ============================================================
#  Generate All PWA Icons from a Source Image
#  Usage: ./generate-icons.sh [source-image]
#  If no source is provided, default is "icon.png"
# ============================================================

SOURCE="${1:-icon.png}"

if [ ! -f "$SOURCE" ]; then
    echo "❌ Error: Source image '$SOURCE' not found."
    exit 1
fi

# List of required sizes
SIZES=(48 72 96 128 144 152 192 256 384 512)

echo "🚀 Generating icons from $SOURCE ..."

# Loop through each size and generate normal icons
for size in "${SIZES[@]}"; do
    OUTPUT="icon-${size}.png"
    echo "  ➜ $OUTPUT (${size}x${size})"
    convert "$SOURCE" -resize "${size}x${size}" -quality 100 "$OUTPUT"
done

# Generate maskable icon (512x512 with 20% padding)
MASKABLE="icon-512-maskable.png"
echo "  ➜ $MASKABLE (512x512, maskable with 20% padding)"
# Resize source to 410x410 (80% of 512) and place it centered on a 512x512 transparent canvas
convert "$SOURCE" -resize 410x410 -background none -gravity center -extent 512x512 -quality 100 "$MASKABLE"

# Optional: create a simple favicon (32x32)
echo "  ➜ favicon.ico (32x32)"
convert "$SOURCE" -resize 32x32 -quality 100 "favicon.ico"

echo "✅ Done! All icons have been generated in the current folder."

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en" dir="ltr">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0, user-scalable=yes" />
    <title>⚡ NEON PROMPT STUDIO — ULTIMATE EDITION</title>

    <!-- ===== PWA & MANIFEST ===== -->
    <link rel="manifest" href="manifest.json" />
    <meta name="theme-color" content="#0a0a14" />
    <meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes" />
    <meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-status-bar-style" content="black-translucent" />
    <meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-title" content="Neon Prompt" />
    <meta name="description" content="Neon Prompt Studio — The ultimate AI prompt engineering toolkit." />

    <!-- ===== ICONS ===== -->
    <link rel="icon" type="image/png" href="icon-192.png" />
    <link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="icon-192.png" />
    <link rel="mask-icon" href="icon-192.png" color="#00d4ff" />

    <!-- ===== FONTS ===== -->
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@300;400;600;700;800;900&display=swap" rel="stylesheet" />
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet" />

    <style>
        /* ================================================================
           NEON PROMPT STUDIO — ULTIMATE EDITION
           Complete UI Framework — 7000+ lines
           ================================================================ */

        /* ---- RESET & BASE ---- */
        *,
        *::before,
        *::after {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
            -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
        }

        :root {
            /* ---- CORE NEON THEME ---- */
            --bg-primary: #08080e;
            --bg-secondary: #0c0c18;
            --bg-surface: rgba(12, 12, 24, 0.92);
            --bg-surface-hover: rgba(18, 18, 34, 0.95);
            --bg-elevated: #10101f;
            --bg-input: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
            --text-primary: #e8e8f0;
            --text-secondary: #b0b0cc;
            --text-muted: #6a6a8a;
            --text-inverse: #08080e;
            --border-light: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
            --border-focus: #00d4ff;
            --shadow-sm: 0 1px 3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
            --shadow-md: 0 4px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
            --shadow-lg: 0 12px 48px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7);
            --shadow-xl: 0 24px 64px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8);
            --radius-sm: 6px;
            --radius-md: 12px;
            --radius-lg: 20px;
            --radius-xl: 28px;
            --transition: 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
            --font-family: 'Inter', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;
            --mono: 'JetBrains Mono', 'Courier New', monospace;

            /* ---- NEON PALETTE ---- */
            --neon-blue: #00d4ff;
            --neon-blue-dim: rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.08);
            --neon-blue-glow: rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.2);
            --neon-purple: #b388ff;
            --neon-purple-dim: rgba(179, 136, 255, 0.08);
            --neon-cyan: #00ffcc;
            --neon-cyan-dim: rgba(0, 255, 204, 0.08);
            --neon-gold: #ffd700;
            --neon-gold-dim: rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.08);
            --neon-red: #ff3d00;
            --neon-red-dim: rgba(255, 61, 0, 0.08);
            --neon-green: #00ff88;
            --neon-green-dim: rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.08);
            --neon-pink: #ff6bff;
            --neon-pink-dim: rgba(255, 107, 255, 0.08);
            --neon-orange: #ff8a4a;
            --neon-orange-dim: rgba(255, 138, 74, 0.08);

            /* ---- UTILITY ---- */
            --success: #22c55e;
            --error: #ef4444;
            --warning: #f59e0b;

            /* ---- SCROLLBAR ---- */
            --scrollbar-track: var(--bg-primary);
            --scrollbar-thumb: var(--neon-blue);

            /* ---- GRADIENTS ---- */
            --gradient-primary: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--neon-blue), var(--neon-purple));
            --gradient-hero: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--neon-blue) 0%, var(--neon-purple) 50%, var(--neon-cyan) 100%);
            --gradient-warm: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--neon-gold), var(--neon-orange));
            --gradient-cool: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--neon-blue), var(--neon-cyan));
            --gradient-neon: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--neon-blue), var(--neon-purple), var(--neon-pink));
        }

        html {
            scroll-behavior: smooth;
            font-size: 16px;
            height: 100%;
        }

        body {
            font-family: var(--font-family);
            background: var(--bg-primary);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            padding: 0;
            transition: background var(--transition), color var(--transition);
            min-height: 100vh;
            min-height: 100dvh;
            direction: ltr;
            line-height: 1.6;
            -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
            -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
            overflow: hidden;
            height: 100%;
            display: flex;
        }

        ::-webkit-scrollbar {
            width: 4px;
            height: 4px;
        }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
            background: transparent;
        }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
            background: var(--scrollbar-thumb);
            border-radius: 10px;
            transition: var(--transition);
        }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
            background: var(--neon-blue);
        }

        /* ---- APP SHELL ---- */
        .app-shell {
            display: flex;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100vh;
            height: 100dvh;
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        /* ---- NEURAL CANVAS (background) ---- */
        #neural-canvas {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            z-index: 0;
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        /* ================================================================
           SIDEBAR — ADVANCED
           ================================================================ */
        .sidebar {
            width: 300px;
            min-width: 300px;
            height: 100%;
            background: rgba(8, 8, 14, 0.98);
            border-right: 1px solid var(--border-light);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            padding: 0;
            backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
            overflow-y: auto;
            overflow-x: hidden;
            transition: transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94);
            z-index: 100;
            flex-shrink: 0;
            position: relative;
        }

        .sidebar::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            height: 2px;
            background: var(--gradient-primary);
            opacity: 0.8;
        }

        .sidebar-header {
            padding: 1.2rem 1.2rem 0.6rem 1.2rem;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-light);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .sidebar-logo {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.6rem;
            font-size: 1.4rem;
            font-weight: 900;
            color: var(--neon-blue);
            text-decoration: none;
            letter-spacing: -0.3px;
            text-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.15);
            transition: var(--transition);
        }

        .sidebar-logo:hover {
            text-shadow: 0 0 60px rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.25);
        }

        .sidebar-logo .sub {
            font-weight: 300;
            color: rgba(232, 232, 240, 0.3);
            font-size: 0.6rem;
            letter-spacing: 1.5px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        .sidebar-logo .badge-neon {
            background: var(--neon-purple);
            color: #fff;
            font-size: 0.45rem;
            padding: 1px 8px;
            border-radius: 12px;
            font-weight: 700;
            letter-spacing: 0.3px;
            margin-left: 0.2rem;
        }

        .sidebar-stats {
            display: flex;
            gap: 0.8rem;
            padding: 0.6rem 1.2rem;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-light);
            flex-shrink: 0;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .sidebar-stats .stat-item {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.3rem;
            font-size: 0.65rem;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            transition: var(--transition);
        }

        .sidebar-stats .stat-item strong {
            color: var(--text-primary);
            font-size: 0.9rem;
        }

        .sidebar-stats .stat-item:hover strong {
            color: var(--neon-blue);
        }

        .sidebar-search-wrap {
            padding: 0.6rem 1.2rem;
            flex-shrink: 0;
            position: relative;
        }

        .sidebar-search-wrap input {
            width: 100%;
            background: var(--bg-input);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
            border-radius: 25px;
            padding: 0.5rem 1rem 0.5rem 2.2rem;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            font-family: var(--font-family);
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            outline: none;
            transition: 0.3s;
        }

        .sidebar-search-wrap input:focus {
            border-color: var(--neon-blue);
            box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.08);
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
        }

        .sidebar-search-wrap input::placeholder {
            color: var(--text-muted);
        }

        .sidebar-search-wrap .search-icon {
            position: absolute;
            left: 1.2rem;
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        .sidebar-nav {
            flex: 1;
            overflow-y: auto;
            padding: 0.4rem 0.6rem 1rem 0.6rem;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 0.08rem;
        }

        .sidebar-nav .nav-section-title {
            font-size: 0.55rem;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 1.5px;
            color: rgba(232, 232, 240, 0.15);
            padding: 0.6rem 0.6rem 0.2rem 0.6rem;
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        .sidebar-nav button {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.5rem;
            width: 100%;
            text-align: left;
            background: transparent;
            border: none;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            font-family: var(--font-family);
            font-size: 0.78rem;
            padding: 0.4rem 0.7rem;
            border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: 0.22s;
            white-space: nowrap;
            font-weight: 500;
        }

        .sidebar-nav button:hover {
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .sidebar-nav button.active {
            background: var(--neon-blue-dim);
            color: var(--neon-blue);
            font-weight: 700;
            box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.1);
        }

        .sidebar-nav button .badge-cnt {
            margin-left: auto;
            font-size: 0.55rem;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
            padding: 0.1rem 0.4rem;
            border-radius: 15px;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        .sidebar-nav button.active .badge-cnt {
            background: rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.08);
            color: var(--neon-blue);
        }

        .sidebar-footer {
            padding: 0.6rem 1.2rem;
            border-top: 1px solid var(--border-light);
            flex-shrink: 0;
            font-size: 0.55rem;
            color: rgba(232, 232, 240, 0.12);
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
        }

        .sidebar-footer .dot {
            width: 5px;
            height: 5px;
            background: var(--neon-blue);
            border-radius: 50%;
            display: inline-block;
            animation: pulse-dot 2s infinite;
        }

        @keyframes pulse-dot {
            0%,
            100% {
                opacity: 0.3;
            }
            50% {
                opacity: 1;
            }
        }

        /* ================================================================
           MAIN CONTENT — ADVANCED
           ================================================================ */
        .main-content {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            height: 100%;
            overflow: hidden;
            position: relative;
        }

        .main-top-bar {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.8rem;
            padding: 0.5rem 1.2rem;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-light);
            flex-shrink: 0;
            background: rgba(8, 8, 14, 0.8);
            backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
            min-height: 52px;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .main-top-bar .breadcrumb {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.3rem;
            font-size: 0.75rem;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            font-weight: 500;
        }

        .main-top-bar .breadcrumb .active-bread {
            color: var(--text-primary);
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        .main-top-bar .breadcrumb .sep {
            color: var(--text-muted);
            opacity: 0.3;
        }

        .main-top-bar .actions-row {
            margin-left: auto;
            display: flex;
            gap: 0.4rem;
            align-items: center;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .main-top-bar .actions-row button {
            background: var(--bg-input);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            padding: 0.3rem 0.8rem;
            border-radius: 20px;
            cursor: pointer;
            font-family: var(--font-family);
            font-size: 0.65rem;
            transition: 0.25s;
            white-space: nowrap;
            font-weight: 500;
        }

        .main-top-bar .actions-row button:hover {
            border-color: var(--neon-blue-glow);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            background: rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.03);
        }

        .main-top-bar .actions-row button.fav-active {
            border-color: rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.3);
            color: var(--neon-gold);
            background: rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.04);
        }

        .hamburger-btn {
            display: none;
            background: transparent;
            border: none;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            font-size: 1.2rem;
            cursor: pointer;
            padding: 0.2rem 0.4rem;
            border-radius: 8px;
            transition: 0.3s;
        }

        .hamburger-btn:hover {
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
        }

        .main-scroll {
            flex: 1;
            overflow-y: auto;
            overflow-x: hidden;
            padding: 1rem 1.2rem 1.5rem 1.2rem;
            scroll-behavior: smooth;
        }

        /* ================================================================
           NEON PANEL — COACH
           ================================================================ */
        .neon-panel {
            background: var(--bg-surface);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
            border-radius: var(--radius-md);
            padding: 1rem 1.2rem;
            margin-bottom: 1.2rem;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
            box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.02);
        }

        .neon-panel::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: -50%;
            left: -50%;
            width: 200%;
            height: 200%;
            background: radial-gradient(circle at 30% 40%, var(--neon-blue-dim), transparent 70%);
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        .neon-panel .neon-header {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.8rem;
            margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
        }

        .neon-panel .neon-avatar {
            width: 32px;
            height: 32px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--neon-blue-dim);
            border: 1px solid var(--neon-blue-glow);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 1rem;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .neon-panel .neon-name {
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            color: var(--neon-blue);
        }

        .neon-panel .neon-handle {
            font-size: 0.6rem;
            color: var(--text-muted);
        }

        .neon-panel .neon-status {
            margin-left: auto;
            font-size: 0.55rem;
            color: var(--neon-blue);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 4px;
        }

        .neon-panel .neon-status .dot {
            width: 5px;
            height: 5px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--neon-blue);
            animation: pulse-dot 1.5s infinite;
        }

        .neon-panel .neon-body {
            font-size: 0.82rem;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.6;
            padding: 0.2rem 0 0.1rem 0;
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
            min-height: 60px;
        }

        .neon-panel .neon-body .quote {
            font-style: italic;
            color: var(--neon-purple);
            font-weight: 500;
        }

        .neon-panel .neon-actions {
            display: flex;
            gap: 0.4rem;
            margin-top: 0.4rem;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
        }

        .neon-panel .neon-actions button {
            background: var(--neon-blue-dim);
            border: 1px solid var(--neon-blue-glow);
            color: var(--neon-blue);
            padding: 0.25rem 0.9rem;
            border-radius: 20px;
            cursor: pointer;
            font-family: var(--font-family);
            font-size: 0.6rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            transition: 0.25s;
        }

        .neon-panel .neon-actions button:hover {
            background: rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.1);
            border-color: rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.3);
        }

        /* ================================================================
           RANDOM PICKER — ADVANCED
           ================================================================ */
        .random-display {
            background: var(--bg-surface);
            border-radius: var(--radius-md);
            padding: 1.2rem 1.5rem;
            margin-bottom: 1.2rem;
            border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
            text-align: center;
            transition: var(--transition);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .random-display::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: -50%;
            left: -50%;
            width: 200%;
            height: 200%;
            background: radial-gradient(circle at 30% 50%, var(--neon-blue-dim), transparent 70%);
            opacity: 0.4;
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        .random-display .random-title {
            font-size: 1.1rem;
            font-weight: 800;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            margin-bottom: 0.2rem;
            position: relative;
        }

        .random-display .random-text {
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-size: 0.95rem;
            line-height: 1.8;
            margin-bottom: 0.8rem;
            position: relative;
            padding: 0 4px;
            min-height: 60px;
        }

        .random-display .random-meta {
            font-size: 0.7rem;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            display: flex;
            gap: 16px;
            justify-content: center;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            position: relative;
        }

        .random-display .random-meta span {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 4px;
        }

        .random-display .random-actions {
            display: flex;
            gap: 0.5rem;
            justify-content: center;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            margin-top: 0.8rem;
            position: relative;
        }

        .random-display .random-actions button {
            padding: 0.4rem 1.2rem;
            border: none;
            border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
            font-weight: 600;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: var(--transition);
            font-size: 0.75rem;
            background: var(--bg-input);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
            font-family: var(--font-family);
        }

        .random-display .random-actions .btn-primary {
            background: var(--neon-blue);
            color: #ffffff;
            border-color: var(--neon-blue);
        }

        .random-display .random-actions .btn-primary:hover {
            background: var(--neon-purple);
            border-color: var(--neon-purple);
            transform: translateY(-2px);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
        }

        .random-display .random-actions button:not(.btn-primary):hover {
            background: var(--neon-blue-dim);
            border-color: var(--neon-blue-glow);
            transform: translateY(-2px);
        }

        /* ================================================================
           STATS DASHBOARD
           ================================================================ */
        .stats-dashboard {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(140px, 1fr));
            gap: 10px;
            margin-bottom: 1.2rem;
        }

        .stats-dashboard .stat-card {
            background: var(--bg-surface);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
            border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
            padding: 0.6rem 0.8rem;
            text-align: center;
            transition: var(--transition);
        }

        .stats-dashboard .stat-card:hover {
            border-color: var(--neon-blue-glow);
            transform: translateY(-2px);
        }

        .stats-dashboard .stat-card .stat-value {
            font-size: 1.4rem;
            font-weight: 800;
            color: var(--neon-blue);
            display: block;
        }

        .stats-dashboard .stat-card .stat-label {
            font-size: 0.55rem;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.5px;
        }

        /* ================================================================
           GRID — ADVANCED
           ================================================================ */
        .grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(300px, 1fr));
            gap: 16px;
            margin-top: 4px;
        }

        .grid-empty {
            grid-column: 1 / -1;
            text-align: center;
            padding: 3rem 1rem;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            font-size: 0.95rem;
            background: var(--bg-surface);
            border-radius: var(--radius-md);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
        }

        .grid-empty .big {
            font-size: 3rem;
            display: block;
            margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
        }

        .grid-empty a {
            color: var(--neon-blue);
            text-decoration: underline;
            cursor: pointer;
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        .grid-empty a:hover {
            color: var(--neon-purple);
        }

        /* ================================================================
           CARDS — ADVANCED
           ================================================================ */
        .card {
            background: var(--bg-surface);
            border-radius: var(--radius-md);
            padding: 1rem 1.1rem 0.9rem;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
            transition: var(--transition);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            position: relative;
            animation: cardFadeUp 0.5s ease forwards;
            opacity: 0;
            cursor: default;
            backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
        }

        .card:hover {
            transform: translateY(-4px);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
            border-color: var(--neon-blue-glow);
        }

        @keyframes cardFadeUp {
            from {
                opacity: 0;
                transform: translateY(16px) scale(0.98);
            }
            to {
                opacity: 1;
                transform: translateY(0) scale(1);
            }
        }

        .card .card-top {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: flex-start;
            gap: 8px;
            margin-bottom: 4px;
        }

        .card .card-top h3 {
            font-size: 0.95rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            line-height: 1.4;
            flex: 1;
        }

        .card .card-top .fav-btn {
            background: none;
            border: none;
            font-size: 1.2rem;
            cursor: pointer;
            padding: 2px 4px;
            transition: var(--transition);
            line-height: 1;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .card .card-top .fav-btn.faved {
            color: var(--neon-gold);
            animation: star-pop 0.3s ease;
        }

        @keyframes star-pop {
            0% {
                transform: scale(0.8);
            }
            50% {
                transform: scale(1.3);
            }
            100% {
                transform: scale(1);
            }
        }

        .card .card-top .fav-btn:hover {
            transform: scale(1.2);
        }

        .card .tags {
            display: flex;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: 4px;
            margin-bottom: 6px;
        }

        .card .tags .tag {
            background: var(--neon-blue-dim);
            color: var(--neon-blue);
            padding: 2px 10px;
            border-radius: 16px;
            font-size: 0.6rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            letter-spacing: 0.3px;
            transition: var(--transition);
            border: 1px solid transparent;
        }

        .card .tags .tag:hover {
            background: var(--neon-blue);
            color: #ffffff;
            border-color: var(--neon-blue);
            transform: scale(1.04);
        }

        .card .tags .tag.custom-tag {
            background: var(--neon-purple-dim);
            color: var(--neon-purple);
        }

        .card .tags .tag.custom-tag:hover {
            background: var(--neon-purple);
            color: #ffffff;
        }

        .card p {
            font-size: 0.82rem;
            line-height: 1.7;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            margin-bottom: 0.8rem;
            flex: 1;
        }

        .card .card-actions {
            display: flex;
            gap: 4px;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            border-top: 1px solid var(--border-light);
            padding-top: 0.6rem;
        }

        .card .card-actions button {
            padding: 4px 10px;
            border: none;
            border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
            font-weight: 600;
            font-size: 0.65rem;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: var(--transition);
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 4px;
            background: var(--bg-input);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
            font-family: var(--font-family);
        }

        .card .card-actions .copy-btn {
            background: var(--neon-blue);
            color: #ffffff;
            border-color: var(--neon-blue);
            flex: 1;
            justify-content: center;
        }

        .card .card-actions .copy-btn:hover {
            background: var(--neon-purple);
            border-color: var(--neon-purple);
            transform: translateY(-1px);
        }

        .card .card-actions .del-btn {
            color: var(--neon-red);
            border-color: var(--neon-red-dim);
            background: var(--neon-red-dim);
        }

        .card .card-actions .del-btn:hover {
            background: var(--neon-red);
            color: #ffffff;
            border-color: var(--neon-red);
        }

        .card .card-actions .share-btn {
            background: transparent;
            border-color: transparent;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            font-size: 1rem;
            padding: 4px 6px;
        }

        .card .card-actions .share-btn:hover {
            background: var(--bg-input);
            border-color: var(--border-light);
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .card.custom-card {
            border-left: 3px solid var(--neon-purple);
        }

        .card.fav-card {
            border-left: 3px solid var(--neon-gold);
        }

        /* ================================================================
           TOAST SYSTEM
           ================================================================ */
        .toast-container {
            position: fixed;
            bottom: 24px;
            right: 24px;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 8px;
            z-index: 99999;
            pointer-events: none;
            max-width: 420px;
        }

        .toast {
            background: rgba(8, 8, 14, 0.96);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            padding: 10px 18px;
            border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-xl);
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(16px) scale(0.96);
            transition: 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1);
            pointer-events: auto;
            font-weight: 500;
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 10px;
            direction: ltr;
            font-family: var(--font-family);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
        }

        .toast.show {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: translateY(0) scale(1);
        }

        .toast.info {
            border-color: var(--neon-blue-glow);
        }

        .toast.success {
            border-color: var(--neon-green);
        }

        .toast.error {
            border-color: var(--neon-red);
        }

        .toast .toast-icon {
            font-size: 1.1rem;
        }

        /* ================================================================
           MODAL — ADVANCED
           ================================================================ */
        .modal-overlay {
            position: fixed;
            inset: 0;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7);
            backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
            display: none;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            z-index: 100000;
            padding: 1rem;
            animation: modalFadeIn 0.25s ease;
        }

        .modal-overlay.open {
            display: flex;
        }

        @keyframes modalFadeIn {
            from {
                opacity: 0;
                backdrop-filter: blur(0px);
            }
            to {
                opacity: 1;
                backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
            }
        }

        .modal {
            background: var(--bg-elevated);
            border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
            padding: 1.5rem 1.8rem;
            max-width: 560px;
            width: 100%;
            max-height: 92vh;
            overflow-y: auto;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-xl);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
            animation: modalSlideUp 0.3s ease;
            direction: ltr;
        }

        @keyframes modalSlideUp {
            from {
                opacity: 0;
                transform: translateY(24px) scale(0.96);
            }
            to {
                opacity: 1;
                transform: translateY(0) scale(1);
            }
        }

        .modal .modal-header {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 10px;
            margin-bottom: 4px;
        }

        .modal .modal-header h2 {
            font-size: 1.2rem;
            font-weight: 800;
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .modal .modal-header .modal-icon {
            font-size: 1.5rem;
        }

        .modal .sub {
            color: var(--text-muted);
            margin-bottom: 1rem;
            font-size: 0.8rem;
        }

        .modal label {
            display: block;
            font-weight: 600;
            margin-bottom: 4px;
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .modal input,
        .modal textarea,
        .modal select {
            width: 100%;
            padding: 8px 12px;
            border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
            background: var(--bg-input);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            transition: var(--transition);
            outline: none;
            margin-bottom: 12px;
            font-family: var(--font-family);
        }

        .modal input:focus,
        .modal textarea:focus,
        .modal select:focus {
            border-color: var(--neon-blue);
            box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--neon-blue-dim);
        }

        .modal textarea {
            min-height: 100px;
            resize: vertical;
        }

        .modal .modal-actions {
            display: flex;
            gap: 8px;
            justify-content: flex-end;
            margin-top: 4px;
        }

        .modal .modal-actions button {
            padding: 8px 22px;
            border: none;
            border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
            font-weight: 600;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: var(--transition);
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            font-family: var(--font-family);
        }

        .modal .modal-actions .btn-cancel {
            background: var(--bg-input);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
        }

        .modal .modal-actions .btn-cancel:hover {
            background: var(--border-light);
        }

        .modal .modal-actions .btn-save {
            background: var(--neon-blue);
            color: #ffffff;
        }

        .modal .modal-actions .btn-save:hover {
            background: var(--neon-purple);
            transform: translateY(-1px);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
        }

        /* ================================================================
           DOPAMINE BANNER
           ================================================================ */
        .dopamine-banner {
            position: fixed;
            top: -100px;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translateX(-50%);
            background: rgba(8, 8, 14, 0.96);
            border: 2px solid var(--neon-blue);
            border-radius: var(--radius-md);
            padding: 0.6rem 1.5rem;
            backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
            box-shadow: 0 0 80px rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.08);
            z-index: 99998;
            text-align: center;
            transition: top 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1);
            max-width: 90%;
        }

        .dopamine-banner.show {
            top: 16px;
        }

        .dopamine-banner .dopamine-icon {
            font-size: 1.8rem;
            display: block;
            margin-bottom: 0.1rem;
        }

        .dopamine-banner .dopamine-title {
            font-size: 1rem;
            font-weight: 900;
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .dopamine-banner .dopamine-title.blue {
            color: var(--neon-blue);
        }

        .dopamine-banner .dopamine-title.purple {
            color: var(--neon-purple);
        }

        .dopamine-banner .dopamine-sub {
            font-size: 0.65rem;
            color: var(--text-muted);
        }

        /* ================================================================
           CONFETTI SYSTEM
           ================================================================ */
        .confetti-overlay {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 99999;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .confetti-overlay .confetti-piece {
            position: absolute;
            width: 6px;
            height: 6px;
            border-radius: 2px;
            animation: confettiFall linear forwards;
        }

        @keyframes confettiFall {
            0% {
                opacity: 1;
                transform: translateY(-20px) rotate(0deg) scale(1);
            }
            100% {
                opacity: 0;
                transform: translateY(100vh) rotate(720deg) scale(0.3);
            }
        }

        /* ================================================================
           SCROLL TO TOP
           ================================================================ */
        .scroll-top {
            position: fixed;
            bottom: 70px;
            right: 20px;
            width: 44px;
            height: 44px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--neon-blue);
            color: #ffffff;
            border: none;
            font-size: 1.2rem;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: var(--transition);
            box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.35);
            opacity: 0;
            transform: scale(0.8);
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 1000;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
        }

        .scroll-top.visible {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: scale(1);
            pointer-events: auto;
        }

        .scroll-top:hover {
            transform: scale(1.1);
            box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.5);
        }

        /* ================================================================
           SIDEBAR OVERLAY (Mobile)
           ================================================================ */
        .sidebar-overlay {
            display: none;
            position: fixed;
            inset: 0;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55);
            z-index: 99;
        }

        /* ================================================================
           BOTTOM NAV (Mobile)
           ================================================================ */
        .bottom-nav {
            display: none;
            position: fixed;
            bottom: 0;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            height: 56px;
            background: rgba(8, 8, 14, 0.96);
            border-top: 1px solid var(--border-light);
            z-index: 200;
            backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
            justify-content: space-around;
            align-items: center;
            padding: 0 0.5rem;
            padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0);
        }

        .bottom-nav button {
            background: transparent;
            border: none;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            font-family: var(--font-family);
            font-size: 0.55rem;
            cursor: pointer;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.1rem;
            padding: 0.2rem 0.5rem;
            border-radius: 8px;
            transition: 0.25s;
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        .bottom-nav button .nav-icon {
            font-size: 1.2rem;
        }

        .bottom-nav button.active {
            color: var(--neon-blue);
        }

        /* ================================================================
           RESPONSIVE — ADVANCED
           ================================================================ */
        @media (max-width: 1024px) {
            .grid {
                grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(280px, 1fr));
            }
            .stats-dashboard {
                grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(110px, 1fr));
            }
        }

        @media (max-width: 900px) {
            .sidebar {
                position: fixed;
                left: 0;
                top: 0;
                height: 100%;
                transform: translateX(-105%);
                box-shadow: 8px 0 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
                width: 280px;
                min-width: 280px;
            }
            .sidebar.open {
                transform: translateX(0);
            }
            .sidebar-overlay.show {
                display: block;
            }
            .main-content {
                width: 100%;
            }
            .main-scroll {
                padding: 0.8rem 0.8rem 4.5rem 0.8rem;
            }
            .main-top-bar {
                padding: 0.4rem 0.8rem;
                gap: 0.4rem;
            }
            .bottom-nav {
                display: flex;
            }
            .grid {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
                gap: 12px;
            }
            .card {
                padding: 0.8rem 0.9rem 0.7rem;
            }
            .card .card-top h3 {
                font-size: 0.85rem;
            }
            .card p {
                font-size: 0.75rem;
            }
            .hamburger-btn {
                display: flex !important;
            }
            .main-top-bar .actions-row button {
                font-size: 0.55rem;
                padding: 0.2rem 0.6rem;
            }
            .random-display .random-text {
                font-size: 0.85rem;
                min-height: 40px;
            }
            .stats-dashboard {
                grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(90px, 1fr));
            }
            .stats-dashboard .stat-card .stat-value {
                font-size: 1.1rem;
            }
        }

        @media (max-width: 500px) {
            .grid {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }
            .main-scroll {
                padding: 0.6rem 0.6rem 4.5rem 0.6rem;
            }
            .random-display {
                padding: 1rem;
            }
            .random-display .random-text {
                font-size: 0.8rem;
            }
            .modal {
                padding: 1.2rem 1rem;
            }
            .sidebar-stats .stat-item {
                font-size: 0.55rem;
            }
            .sidebar-stats .stat-item strong {
                font-size: 0.75rem;
            }
            .toast-container {
                right: 12px;
                left: 12px;
                bottom: 12px;
            }
            .scroll-top {
                right: 14px;
                bottom: 64px;
                width: 38px;
                height: 38px;
                font-size: 1rem;
            }
            .stats-dashboard {
                grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            }
            .stats-dashboard .stat-card .stat-value {
                font-size: 1rem;
            }
        }

        /* ---- Utility Classes ---- */
        .hidden {
            display: none !important;
        }

        .flex-center {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
        }

        .gap-8 {
            gap: 8px;
        }

        .mb-12 {
            margin-bottom: 12px;
        }

        .text-center {
            text-align: center;
        }

        .mt-8 {
            margin-top: 8px;
        }

        .w-full {
            width: 100%;
        }

        .text-blue {
            color: var(--neon-blue);
        }
        .text-purple {
            color: var(--neon-purple);
        }
        .text-cyan {
            color: var(--neon-cyan);
        }
        .text-gold {
            color: var(--neon-gold);
        }
        .text-red {
            color: var(--neon-red);
        }
        .fw-700 {
            font-weight: 700;
        }
        .fw-800 {
            font-weight: 800;
        }
        .fw-900 {
            font-weight: 900;
        }
        .fs-small {
            font-size: 0.7rem;
        }
        .fs-large {
            font-size: 1.2rem;
        }
        .opacity-muted {
            opacity: 0.5;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>

    <!-- ===== NEURAL CANVAS ===== -->
    <canvas id="neural-canvas"></canvas>

    <!-- ===== CONFETTI ===== -->
    <div class="confetti-overlay" id="confettiOverlay"></div>

    <!-- ===== DOPAMINE BANNER ===== -->
    <div class="dopamine-banner" id="dopamineBanner">
        <span class="dopamine-icon" id="dopamineIcon">⚡</span>
        <div class="dopamine-title" id="dopamineTitle">Neon Sync!</div>
        <div class="dopamine-sub" id="dopamineSub">+50 XP · Mind connection strengthened</div>
    </div>

    <!-- ===== TOAST ===== -->
    <div class="toast-container" id="toastContainer"></div>

on:
  push:
    branches: ["main"]

  contents: read

  id-token: write
concurrency:
  group: "pages"
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  deploy:
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Pages
        uses: actions/configure-pages@v5
      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3
        with:
          path: '.'
      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4
